s.h: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab
s.t:
Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung
Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. Wenn deine Bewerbung passt, kontaktieren wir dich für ein erstes Gespräch.
Schritt 2: Gespräche
Im Vorstellungsgespräch - telefonisch, vor Ort oder online - möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir überprüfen, ob deine Erwartungen an die Stelle mit unseren übereinstimmen, welche Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten du mitbringst, ob dich unsere Kultur anspricht und wie du ins Team passt. Bei beidseitigem Interesse und je nach Stelle finden mehrere Gespräche statt. Alle deine Fragen zur Stelle, zum Team oder zu den Anstellungsbedingungen sind immer willkommen.
Schritt 3: Weitere Schritte im Prozess
Je nach Stelle vereinbaren wir einen Probe- oder Schnuppertag, stellen dir eine fachliche Aufgabe, organisieren ein Treffen mit dem Team oder laden zu einem Assessment ein. In der Regel gehören auch Referenzauskünfte zu unserem Bewerbungsablauf. Über alle Schritte im Prozess wirst du transparent informiert.
Schritt 4: Bewerbungsentscheid
Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.

## Company Description ##
**About Syngenta**
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges.

We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact.

Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. **Syngenta has been ranked as a-top employer-by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.**
## Job Description ##
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, we are seeking a **Global Environmental Technology Lead**. This is a hybrid role based primarily in Muttenz, Switzerland, though Monthey can also be considered.
As Global Environmental Technology Lead, you will shape how Production & Supply identifies, develops and deploys the technologies that reduce environmental impact while protecting operational performance and our license to operate.

This is a high-impact global role for an accomplished scientist or engineer who can move confidently between technical depth, strategic direction and practical implementation. You will connect manufacturing sites, process development, environmental specialists and external partners to turn complex environmental challenges into scalable solutions.

* Set the global environmental technology strategy across waste, wastewater, air emissions, vent treatment, recovery and recycling, informed by Best Available Techniques (BAT).
* Identify, assess and mature emerging technologies, taking opportunities from laboratory and pilot-scale evidence through to robust manufacturing application.
* Partner with global and local manufacturing teams to solve critical environmental challenges, improve site performance and safeguard license to operate.
* Provide technical leadership and independent challenge for environmental projects, assessing feasibility, environmental benefit, risk, operability and cost.
* Influence product and process choices early by evaluating waste streams, especially wastewater, during active-ingredient process development.
* Develop practical, high-value solutions that reduce impacts to air, water and land across existing products and manufacturing sites.
* Build and lead a connected global environmental technology community spanning Technology & Engineering, Production & Supply, Environmental Managers, process development teams and external experts.
* Grow internal capabilities through technical coaching, knowledge exchange, training, literature reviews and partnerships with suppliers, consultants and technology providers.
* Translate complex environmental science and regulation into clear choices and decisive action for technical and business stakeholders.

* Master-s degree, or equivalent, in Chemistry, Chemical Process Engineering or a related discipline.
* Ideally 10+ years- experience in industrial chemical operations and/or process development.
* Demonstrated expertise in environmental technologies and a practical understanding of environmental legislation.
* Able to remain focused, resilient and effective in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Strong knowledge of waste, wastewater, emissions, recovery and recycling technologies.
* Solid grounding in organic and inorganic chemistry, chemical processes and process engineering; agrochemical production knowledge is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of environmental toxicity, chemical bio-transformation and environmental risk assessment.
* Proven ability to lead teams or workstreams in project, departmental or matrix environments.
* Experience in project and change management, with resilience in ambiguous environments.
* Strong analytical, conceptual, organisational and negotiation skills.
* Clear communication and stakeholder-influencing skills at all levels.
* Experience working across multicultural, multinational teams, with a recognised record of technical delivery.
* Fluent business English; French is highly advantageous.
## Additional Information ##

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:
* We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
* The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta-s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
* A super working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
* The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
* Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
* You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance-)

## Introduction de la société ##
Comadur SA, Leader mondial de la production de composants en matériaux durs Swiss Made. Nous faisons partie du Swatch Group, premier fabricant mondial de produits horlogers. * Un espace de travail moderne et agréable.
* Des conditions sociales de premier ordre.
* Une équipe dynamique, exigeante, à l-écoute et toujours en quête de nouveaux défis.
* Une volonté commune : collaborer et grandir ensemble pour devenir un partenaire incontournable.
## Description du poste ##
* Manager et être l-acteur principal de plusieurs projets d-industrialisation, d'un point de vue technique et administratif :

* Etre garant de la stabilité et de la fiabilité technique des équipements et procédés mis en place.
* Soutien à la production en termes de résolution de problèmes et d-amélioration continue.
## Profil ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d-un diplôme «Ingénieur HES» ou «Technicien ET».
* Vous êtes pluridisciplinaire et expérimenté : mécanique, automatisation, procédés, fortement intéressé à la fois par l-automation et les procédés spécifiques aux matériaux durs.
* Vous avez de l-expérience dans le suivi de projets industriels (automatisation + procédés de fabrication).
* Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et de langue maternelle française, ainsi que bonnes connaissances d-anglais et d-allemand.
* Vous êtes flexible au niveau des déplacements sur les différents sites de l-entreprise.
* Vous êtes doté d-une personnalité technique, résistante, constructive, proactive, communicative et structurée.
## Compétences requises ##
Nous recherchons une personne organisée, capable de travailler en multitâches avec d-excellentes qualités relationnelles tant avec les interlocuteurs externes et internes.
Dotée d-une bonne ouverture d-esprit, de créativité et de dynamisme, sachant prendre du recul et être à l-écoute.

Français, l'anglais est un atout.

## Bereichsleitung Sozialberatung und Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung (80-100 %) ##
Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Sozialberatung
Die Sozialberatung ist eines der zentralen Angebote von Pro Senectute Kanton Luzern. Rund 25 Mitarbeitende an den Standorten Luzern, Emmen und Willisau sowie bei der Infostelle Demenz beraten und begleiten ältere Menschen und ihre Angehörigen in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen.
Als Bereichsleitung tragen Sie die personelle, fachliche und finanzielle Verantwortung für diesen wichtigen Bereich. Gleichzeitig sind Sie Teil unserer vierköpfigen Geschäftsleitung.
Ihre Aufgaben
* Sie führen den Bereich Sozialberatung und entwickeln ihn mit Blick auf gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und die zukünftigen Bedürfnisse älterer Menschen und ihrer Angehörigen gemeinsam mit den Mitarbeitenden weiter.
* Direkte Führung der Stellenleitenden der Beratungsstellen Emmen und Willisau, der Leitung Infostelle Demenz sowie des Teams Sozialberatung Luzern
* Sie verantworten Budget, Ressourcenplanung, Reporting und Zielerreichung des Bereichs.
* Sie stellen eine hohe fachliche Qualität sicher und fördern die Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden.
* Sie übernehmen in einem begrenzten Umfang, ca. 10%, eigene Sozialberatungen und bleiben damit nahe an der Praxis und den Bedürfnissen unserer Klientel.
* Sie pflegen und entwickeln die Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Behörden und Fachorganisationen weiter und verantworten Leistungsvereinbarungen und Verträge.
* Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie Mitverantwortung für die Gesamtorganisation und wirken bei strategischen Fragestellungen, Organisationsentwicklungen und bereichsübergreifenden Projekten mit.
Das bringen Sie mit
* Einen Abschluss in Sozialer Arbeit auf Tertiärstufe oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Eine Weiterbildung in Führung, Management oder Organisationsentwicklung
* Mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung, vorzugsweise im Sozial-, Gesundheits- oder Non-Profit-Bereich
* Freude, Menschen zu führen, Mitarbeitende zu entwickeln und gemeinsam Veränderungen zu gestalten
* Die Fähigkeit, fachliche, personelle und betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen miteinander zu verbinden
* Strategisches und vernetztes Denken sowie ein gutes Verständnis für organisatorische und finanzielle Zusammenhänge
* Eine überzeugende Kommunikation und ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Mitarbeitenden, Behörden, Gemeinden und weiteren Partnerorganisationen
* Interesse an gesellschaftlichen und sozialpolitischen Fragestellungen rund um das Alter
* Eine selbständige, verantwortungsbewusste und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Darauf können Sie sich freuen
Sie übernehmen eine vielseitige Führungsaufgabe mit Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie führen einen etablierten sowie fachlich starken Bereich und erhalten gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, dessen zukünftige Ausrichtung aktiv mitzuprägen.
Als Mitglied der vierköpfigen Geschäftsleitung wirken Sie über Ihren eigenen Bereich hinaus und übernehmen Mitverantwortung an der operativen Entwicklung von Pro Senectute Kanton Luzern. Damit verbinden Sie operative Nähe mit strategischem Einfluss.
Sie bewegen sich in einem vielseitigen Umfeld an der Schnittstelle zwischen Sozialer Arbeit, Führung, Organisationsentwicklung und der Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Behörden und Fachorganisationen.
Ein engagiertes und kompetentes Team sowie ein unterstützendes Führungsteam erwartet Sie mit Freude. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit für mobil flexibles Arbeiten tragen unter anderem zu einem zeitgemässen Arbeitsumfeld bei. Wir unterstützen Ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung und ermöglichen entsprechende Weiterbildungen. Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Luzern.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, inklusive Motivationsschreiben, an: bewerbung@lu.prosenectute.ch

JUUL Labs is seeking a multifunctional Manufacturing Operations Program Manager to join our Global Supply Chain team. This hybrid role bridges day-to-day contract manufacturing execution with strategic, end-to-end supply chain management.
The mission of this role is to ensure we build products at the right speed (time to market), right price (fully burdened cost), right capacity, and right flexibility to meet the company's growth needs. Acting as a critical operational liaison, you will oversee the complete lifecycle of new and existing products across our global supplier network.
Looking for Candidate in Region who can travel to manufacturing site in Cookeville, TN as needed.

Time to Market & Operational Execution
Launch Optimization: Optimize product supply chains for speed to successfully meet market demand and product launch timelines.
Lead Time Reduction: Work closely with product development and manufacturing teams to minimize lead times while maintaining strict quality standards.
Day-to-Day Oversight: Interface daily with suppliers to manage operational execution, focusing heavily on On-Time Delivery (OTD), Overall Operational Effectiveness (OOE), and forecast execution.
Cost Management & Financial Acumen
Fully Burdened Cost Tracking: Manage total product supply chain costs to ensure the fully burdened price (including material, labor, overhead, and logistics) directly aligns with corporate profitability margins.
Should-Cost Strategy: Partner with finance and engineering to build aggressive should-costs and clear capital expenditure forecasts.
Commercial Negotiations: Negotiate with key suppliers to secure favorable pricing, tooling/equipment budgets, and business terms without compromising product quality.
Capacity Planning, Flexibility & Scalability
Constraint Mitigation: Evaluate production constraints and manage global manufacturing capacity to seamlessly support current volumes and future product roadmaps.
Ramp & Scale Planning: Collaborate with manufacturing partners on staffing, facility foot printing, and equipment allocation to ensure infrastructure is scalable for company growth.
Adaptability: Implement flexible supply chain strategies capable of responding rapidly to market fluctuations, operational bottlenecks, and demand shifts.
Supplier Relationship & Risk Management
Strategic Alignment: Build, evaluate, and maintain relationships with critical contract manufacturers and component vendors to align them with JUUL's operational targets.
Contingency Planning: Anticipate vulnerabilities and draft proactive business continuity plans to mitigate risks associated with vendor performance, geopolitical fluctuations, and macro supply disruptions.
Performance Quality: Establish metric scorecards and Clear to Build (CTB) tracking to eliminate post-ramp qualifications and unexpected disruptions.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Continuous Improvement
Primary Liaison: Act as the primary champion and operational advocate across engineering, quality, product management, logistics, and finance.
Process Excellence: Utilize KPIs to actively monitor supply chain performance, using a data-driven "sixth sense" to spark continuous improvement, process modifications, and cost-saving loops.

Experience: 5+ years of global supply chain management or complex manufacturing experience (highly preferred in Consumer Electronics, Medical Device, Aerospace, Automotive, or Pharmaceutical industries).
Leadership & Influence: Proven history of leading and influencing cross-functional matrixed teams and external partners toward aggressive timelines without relying on direct authority.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you’ll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you'll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Allocated Bullion Exchange (ABX) is the world’s leading electronic institutional exchange for allocated physical precious metals. The Reinsurance Implementation Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful delivery of reinsurance system implementation, transformation, migration, and enhancement projects for insurance and reinsurance clients. This role oversees the full project lifecycle, including planning, governance, execution, risk management, stakeholder engagement, budget control, and delivery management.
The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with deep knowledge of reinsurance operations and implementation methodologies. This individual serves as the primary liaison between clients, business stakeholders, technical teams, and executive leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while achieving expected business outcomes.
Experience implementing DXC SICS or comparable reinsurance administration platforms is highly desirable.
DXC Reinsurance Project Manager

· Lead the end-to-end delivery of DXC Assure Reinsurance implementation projects, DXC’s end-to-end reinsurance administration application, ensuring successful delivery across discovery, planning, configuration, data migration, integration, testing, training, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.

· Manage and lead one or more complex implementation projects, ensuring adherence to agreed scope, schedule, budget, contractual commitments, delivery methodology, and quality standards.

· Act as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for the customer, coordinating closely with customer project managers, business sponsors, IT sponsors, subject matter experts, DXC delivery leadership, product teams, technical architects, business analysts, data migration teams, reporting specialists, hosting/cloud teams, and account leadership.

· Develop, maintain, and manage detailed project plans, milestone schedules, resource plans, financial forecasts, RAID logs, communication plans, governance calendars, and project status reporting materials.

· Drive project governance through regular project meetings, steering committee preparation, executive-level status reporting, escalation management, and clear decision tracking.

· Monitor project progress against plan, proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive timely mitigation, resolution, and escalation where required.

· Manage scope and change control, ensuring that new requirements, revised assumptions, delivery impacts, schedule changes, or budget variances are documented, assessed, approved, and communicated in accordance with DXC and customer governance processes.

· Coordinate the delivery of key implementation workstreams, including discovery workshops, project definition documentation, solution configuration, reference data setup, security setup, data migration, interface support, business intelligence/reporting, functional acceptance testing, user acceptance testing, production cutover, and transition to support.

· Partner with reinsurance business analysts and solution leads to ensure that customer requirements are aligned to standard DXC Assure Reinsurance capabilities, with appropriate focus on minimizing customization and promoting best-practice adoption.

· Coordinate with technical architects and hosting/cloud teams to ensure environments are provisioned, connectivity is established, single sign-on and access requirements are managed, and technical dependencies are addressed in support of the project schedule.

· Oversee project financial management, including budget tracking, estimate validation, earned value or forecast updates where applicable, revenue recognition inputs, resource utilization, billing support, and early warning of potential cost or margin variances.

· Manage project resources across geographically distributed teams, including onshore, nearshore, offshore, product, technical, and customer-facing resources, ensuring assignments, availability, priorities, and dependencies are actively controlled.

· Ensure project deliverables are produced, reviewed, approved, and stored in accordance with agreed standards, including project plans, status reports, decision logs, acceptance documents, cutover plans, test progress reporting, and implementation governance materials.

· Support customer readiness activities, including training planning, business process alignment, operational readiness, user acceptance testing coordination, cutover preparation, go/no-go planning, and early-life support transition.

· Promote a collaborative “one team” delivery culture between DXC and customer teams while maintaining appropriate delivery discipline, accountability, and commercial control.

· Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, presenting project status, key risks, decisions required, financial impacts, and delivery options in a clear, concise, and executive-ready manner.

· Contribute to continuous improvement of DXC Reinsurance delivery practices, including standardized project templates, estimation approaches, delivery playbooks, lessons learned, and project management best practices.

· Stay current on DXC Assure Reinsurance implementation approaches, product roadmap considerations, reinsurance market practices, and delivery methods applicable to complex insurance technology transformation programs.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. A major function of the Office of Data Acquisitions is to provide databases developed from state highway safety related data for use in analyses aimed at reducing deaths, injuries, crashes, and medical costs.

As the Director, the incumbent will be responsible for the following: Advising the Associate Administrator on all matters related to the design, development, coordination, and management of crash investigation and data collection, and their contribution to achieving the mission of NHTSA.

Keeps the Associate Administrator fully informed as to the status of programs and of problems and controversial issues.

Collaborates closely with the Associate Administrator and other top officials of NHTSA to identify the agency's crash research and data needs, to determine techniques and methods by which the office can meet those needs, to estimate the cost and time required to meet the needs, and to determine other implications of changes.

Carrying out personnel management responsibilities for a staff of professional, technical, administrative and clerical support personnel. Makes decisions on work problems presented by subordinate supervisors and key specialists.

Evaluates performance of subordinate supervisors and reviews evaluations made by supervisors of subordinate employee's performance. Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the State Data Reporting Systems Division responsible for the crash record-based data.

Crash record based data includes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), a fundamental national data base on traffic safety, Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), Not-in-Traffic System (NTS) and the State Electronic Data Collection Program (SEDC)., The Division also provides the expertise in sample design and quality control to the other offices in the National Center for Statistics and Analysis, the rest of NHTSA and other offices in DOT.

Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the Crash Investigation Division (CID), provides executive leadership in the planning, design, development, coordination, and management of national networks of motor vehicle traffic crash research and data collection activities.

These include the operation of a national system to conduct detailed investigations of a well-defined selection of motor vehicle crashes currently the Crash Investigation Sampling System (CISS)); and the Special Crash Investigations (SCI) program of special investigations of crashes of particular, interest; and Systems for collecting, supplementing, and coding data from police crash reports to provide special purpose data files.

Maintaining liaison with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, police agencies, hospitals, private safety groups, motor vehicle and equipment manufacturers, crash research and analysis organizations, professional societies, and other groups with an interest in crash investigation and crash data for the purposes are for exchanging crash data and information on crash research technology, encouraging the use of crash data, and cooperating on crash research programs.

The ideal candidate is a data executive and systems expert with a track record of managing federal data collection, automation, and national crash investigation programs.

They possess the strategic and technical skills to lead multi-disciplinary teams while directing the human resource, budgetary, and procurement parameters vital to national highway safety initiatives.

A skilled collaborator, they excel at building partnerships across federal, state, and private sectors including law enforcement, public health, and the automotive industry to secure cooperation and advance data systems.

Furthermore, they bring expertise in data governance, enforcing quality control and data completeness while protecting individual privacy, ensuring the delivery of accurate databases that support national safety research and rulemaking.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications.

To qualify for the Grade 15, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-14, it must include: Experience directing multi-disciplinary professional, technical, and administrative teams while managing the organizational, human resource, and budgetary parameters vital to national highway traffic safety initiatives.

Experience communicating with system managers, rulemaking engineers, researchers, technicians, traffic safety administrators, Governor's Representatives for Highway Safety, State and local officials, national data system program managers and others associated with the application of data as it applies to helping solve complex safety issues.

Experience establishing policy and overseeing large federal data divisions to ensure data completeness, security, and rigorous quality control. Examples include working with executive leadership to plan, develop, and manage large-scale national data collection systems and multi-level crash investigation programs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of federal budgeting to manage large divisional funds, appropriations, large-scale national data architecture, data collection methodologies, complex procurement or contracting mechanisms and systems engineering principles required to build and sustain nationwide databases.

Leadership and Supervision: Management and/or team leader skills, including the ability to direct, manage, and develop a diverse, high-performing human resources workforce of technical and administrative staff.

Communication: Communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure community support, build strategic intergovernmental alliances, and establish private-sector data-sharing partnerships.

Reasoning: Ability to collaborate across federal, state, and private boundaries to improve data accessibility while balancing competing stakeholder priorities.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

As Growth Products GTM & Program Manager for APAC, you will be the dedicated go-to-market architect and program execution lead for ServiceNow's highest-priority growth products across the region.

Specifically, you will own the GTM strategy and regional program management for Security and Identity solutions (Armis, Veza), AI-powered employee productivity (Moveworks), and the AI control tower (AICT) suite - driving pipeline, sales activation, and customer adoption across India, Asia & Korea, and ANZ.
This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. You will translate global product GTM strategies into APAC-ready programs that field teams can land and scale.

Working alongside regional Business Managers, field sales, marketing, and channel teams, you will design and run the plays, cadences, and programs that move these products from emerging to established motions in the region.

A core part of your mandate is driving AI acceleration - ensuring the field is equipped, activated, and executing on AI-native opportunities across all growth products.
This role requires someone who thrives at the pace of a product launch - able to hold multiple GTM programs simultaneously, build trust with both product specialist teams and field sales, and turn strategy into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You will have direct visibility into ServiceNow's most strategically important growth bets and the opportunity to shape how APAC leads the way in making them successful.

Own the end-to-end GTM program for Armis, Veza, Moveworks, and AICT across APAC. Design and execute regional landing plans for each product, working with global product teams to translate strategy into APAC-contextualized plays, coverage models, and pipeline programs.
Drive sales activation and field readiness across APAC markets for the growth products. Build and deliver enablement programs, landing kits, and competitive positioning that equip field teams to identify, qualify, and close growth product opportunities.
Lead AI native sales acceleration across the APAC field. Define the APAC approach to AI-native selling, track adoption across regions, identify blockers, and work with the Head of APAC GTM and regional Business Managers to drive consistent execution against AI-native pipeline targets.
Build and manage program cadences across all growth products — tracking deal momentum, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution. Maintain a clear view of pipeline health, top opportunities, and program risks across the portfolio.
Partner with Marketing to co-design and execute demand generation programs, events, and pipeline acceleration campaigns specific to growth products. Ensure marketing investment is aligned to the moments and accounts that matter most for each product.
Coordinate with partner teams to integrate the channel into growth product GTM motions. Define the partner play for each product, identify top partners by Major Area, and ensure partner-sourced pipeline is tracked and accelerating.
Represent the growth products portfolio in APAC pipeline reviews, QBRs, and leadership forums. Provide structured updates on program performance, pipeline coverage, and execution gaps — with clear recommendations for intervention.
Serve as the APAC voice to global product and GTM teams for Armis, Veza, Moveworks, and AICT. Surface APAC-specific market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and execution feedback that informs global strategy and product roadmap decisions.

s.h: To be successful in this role you have
s.t:
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
~10 years of total work experience, with 5+ years in GTM strategy, sales strategy, product GTM, or program management in enterprise software or SaaS.
Demonstrated experience running go-to-market programs for emerging or recently launched enterprise products - including sales enablement, pipeline generation, field activation, and adoption tracking.
Strong understanding of enterprise software sales motions, including specialist sales, channel/partner dynamics, and the interplay between field sales and product GTM teams. Experience with security, identity, or AI product categories is a plus.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent programs at pace - comfortable holding four product motions simultaneously, prioritizing across competing demands, and delivering through influence rather than authority.
Cross-functional collaborator who builds trust quickly with both field-facing and product-facing stakeholders.
Strong analytical capabilities - able to build pipeline models, track program performance, identify gaps, and present clear, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.
APAC experience and regional awareness strongly preferred. Understands the market dynamics, customer buying patterns, and cultural nuances across India, Asia & Korea, and ANZ, and knows how to adapt global GTM plays accordingly.
Exceptional communicator - clear, concise, and confident in both executive forums and working sessions. Able to prepare and deliver crisp updates to senior stakeholders and facilitate cross-functional alignment with ease.
Self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, high-growth environments. Energized by building structure where none exists, moving fast, and learning new product domains quickly.

The Infrastructure Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure services across both Cloud and On-Premises environments. This role ensures that infrastructure services meet business requirements, service level commitments, security standards, and operational excellence .

The individual will act as the key interface between technical teams, business stakeholders, customers, and external service providers to ensure reliable, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure services.

Lead the end-to-end delivery and management of infrastructure services across Cloud and On-Premises environments, including servers, storage, virtualization, networks, databases, and platform services.
Manage infrastructure operations teams and service providers, ensuring high availability, performance, and timely resolution of incidents, problems, and service requests in accordance with agreed SLAs and KPIs.
Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and customers regarding infrastructure service performance, escalations, and operational governance.
Collaborate with business units, application teams, cybersecurity teams, and technology partners to align infrastructure services with organizational objectives and transformation initiatives.
Drive continuous service improvement initiatives focused on reliability, automation, optimization, operational efficiency, and user experience.
Oversee infrastructure lifecycle management, including capacity planning, patching, upgrades, refresh programs, and technology modernization initiatives.
Ensure effective management of Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and On-Premises data center environments, maintaining operational consistency and governance standards.
Monitor infrastructure health, service performance, utilization, and availability metrics; prepare operational reports and present insights to senior leadership.
Ensure compliance with ITIL best practices, security policies, regulatory requirements, and organizational governance frameworks.
Lead incident, problem, change, and release management processes to minimize service disruptions and ensure business continuity.
Coordinate disaster recovery planning, business continuity testing, and resilience initiatives across infrastructure environments.
Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and third-party service providers to ensure service quality, cost optimization, and contractual compliance.
Facilitate knowledge sharing, operational readiness, and team development to enhance technical capabilities and service maturity.

Bachelor’s degree/Master’s degree(BE/ME) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Experience : 10+ Years

Proven experience (8+ years) in hybrid infrastructure environment including Cloud and On-premises platforms
Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and Service Management principles.
Experience managing infrastructure services such as compute, Storage, Virtualization, networking and monitoring
Knowledge of Cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to handle multiple priorities and complex projects.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL, AWS, Azure, GCP, PMP, or Prince2 are preferred.

Description de l'entreprise
Rejoignez Nescens, la marque suisse experte en longévité.
Nescens est une institution suisse de référence dans les domaines de la médecine préventive et de la longévité. Elle réunit deux univers complémentaires : une ligne de skincare scientifique, nos cosméceutiques, distribuée dans un réseau de point de ventes sélectifs et en ligne, et des programmes de bilan diagnostique et de longévité dispensés en clinique et dans des établissements hôteliers partenaires de référence.
Basée sur le prestigieux campus médical de Genolier, Nescens fait partie d'un écosystème unique où la science, la médecine et le bien\-être se rencontrent.
Rejoindre Nescens, c'est intégrer un environnement dynamique, stimulant et tourné vers l'innovation, au cœur de la science suisse de la longévité.
Description du poste
L'IT Project Manager "” ERP \& Digital Systems est à la fois le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble des systèmes opérationnels et digitaux de Nescens, et le chef de projet des initiatives IT structurantes.

Il/elle administre, configure et développe la stack technologique; en particulier Microsoft Business Central, dont il/elle assure la maîtrise fonctionnelle et technique; pilote les projets de développement et d'intégration de bout en bout, et intervient en première ligne lorsqu'un dysfonctionnement impacte les opérations.

Son ancrage technique s'accompagne d'une compréhension concrète des enjeux e\-commerce et CRM : il/elle sait que derrière chaque système, il y a une transaction, un client ou une action marketing à activer.
Responsabilités
Pilotage de projets IT
Piloter de bout en bout les projets IT structurants de Nescens : développement d'applications, lancement de plateforme B2B, intégration de systèmes de paiement, connexions avec les plateformes logistiques
Cadrer les projets : définition des besoins, rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles, sélection et coordination des prestataires techniques, suivi des développements, recette et déploiement
Gérer les priorités, les délais et les risques projet en assurant une communication régulière auprès des parties prenantes internes
Assurer la veille technologique et proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins opérationnels et commerciaux de Nescens
Microsoft Business Central "” administration et développement
Assurer la maîtrise fonctionnelle et l'administration de Business Central en tant qu'ERP central de Nescens : paramétrage métier, gestion des entités (clients, fournisseurs, articles, comptabilité), configuration des workflows et des rapports, gestion des droits et des utilisateurs
Réaliser des personnalisations et des développements légers en AL (langage Business Central) : extensions, modifications de rapports, automatisations de workflows, adaptations d'interface , afin de limiter le recours systématique à des prestataires externes
Gérer les mises à jour et les évolutions de la plateforme, en assurant la compatibilité avec les extensions et intégrations en place
Être le référent interne sur toutes les questions relatives à BC, pour les équipes finance, commerce et opérations
Intégration et continuité opérationnelle
Concevoir et maintenir les flux de données entre systèmes (stocks, commandes, paiements, contacts) pour garantir la cohérence de l'information à travers l'ensemble des plateformes
Configurer et maintenir les autres plateformes de l'écosystème (Salesforce, Shopify, Adyen, Klaviyo, Storyblok) selon les besoins opérationnels et commerciaux
Diagnostiquer et résoudre les dysfonctionnements en temps réel, en intervenant directement sur les paramétrages ou en coordonnant les correctifs avec les prestataires techniques
Mettre en place des procédures de monitoring et d'alerte pour anticiper les incidents avant qu'ils n'affectent les opérations ou l'expérience client
Support CRM, e\-commerce et coordination agence
Assurer le bon fonctionnement des outils CRM (Salesforce, Klaviyo) et e\-commerce (Shopify, Adyen) pour permettre l'activation des actions marketing, la fluidité des parcours d'achat et la fiabilité des encaissements
Identifier et corriger les points de friction techniques qui impactent la conversion ou l'expérience client

**Public Services International (PSI)** is the global union federation for public service workers, representing over 30 million employees through affiliated unions worldwide. PSI works to promote quality public services, defend workers' rights, advance social justice, and strengthen public institutions for the benefit of all.
## Job Description ##
**HR Strategy & Organisational Leadership**
* Develop and implement a global People Strategy that supports PSI's political priorities, organisational sustainability, and long-term workforce needs.
* Act as a strategic advisor to the Senior Management Team (SMT) on people-related matters, organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, and talent management, and social dialogue including with union and staff representatives.
* Lead organisational design and change management initiatives aimed at strengthening operational effectiveness, employee engagement, and organisational resilience.
* Develop and implement that people policies, practices, and initiatives that are aligned with PSI's values, culture, and strategic objectives.
**Global People Operations & Compliance**
* Oversee the delivery of global HR operations across all PSI locations, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and compliance with local employment legislation and organisational policies.
* Lead and continuously improve people processes, including recruitment, onboarding, employee lifecycle management, contract administration, and offboarding.
* Ensure legal and regulatory compliance across all regions and country offices, mitigating employment-related risks and maintaining best practice HR standards.
* Manage global HR systems, records, reporting, and people analytics to support informed decision-making.
**Talent Management & Employee Development**
* Lead global workforce planning and succession planning processes to ensure organisational continuity and future capability.
* Develop and implement learning, leadership development, and career growth initiatives that strengthen organisational performance and employee engagement.
* Oversee performance management processes, ensuring managers are equipped to support high performance and professional development.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, feedback, and accountability across the organisation.
**Employee Relations, Wellbeing & Inclusion**
* Champion a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and psychologically safe workplace where all employees can thrive.
* Lead initiatives related to employee wellbeing, health and safety, and duty of care across all PSI locations.
* Provide expert guidance on complex employee relations matters, conflict resolution, and workplace investigations where required.
* Foster positive social dialogue and constructive engagement with employee and union representatives.
**HR Business Partnering**
* Serve as the global HR Business Partner for managers and staff across headquarters, regional offices, and country offices.
* Support leaders in people management, team development, performance management, workforce planning, and employee engagement.
* Coach and advise managers on leadership effectiveness, employee relations, talent development, and organisational change.

* Partner closely with the Finance team on headcount planning, people budgeting, workforce costs, and HR-related financial reporting.

As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.
The Senior Campaigns Manager will play a key role in delivering FIFA-s social impact campaigns by sharing the lead in the overall conception, creation, delivery and management of results-driven and multiplatform initiatives, in line with FIFA-s Strategic Objectives for the Global Game: 2023-2027.
Reporting to the Team Lead Corporate Communications, the postholder will own and oversee the portfolio of FIFA social impact campaigns, serving as the main point of contact between functional areas and leading and managing the relationship with external stakeholders.

* Plan and implement compelling social impact campaigns related to FIFA-s corporate mission
* Project-manage all stakeholder involvement by acting as the main point of contact in relation to social impact campaigns, developing content proposals, agreeing on budgets and managing feedback
* Project-manage all deliverables involving internal and external partners and execute campaign requirements with an emphasis on digital communication to promote individual stakeholder activities across FIFA-s platforms and events

s.h: * Project-manage all requirements in terms of content production
s.t:
* Project-manage all campaign reporting and debriefs according to pre-agreed key performance indicators
* Support the further promotion of social impact campaigns with plans, messaging and content around key milestones
* Support the further promotion of social impact campaigns through the creation of multilingual toolkits for Member Associations and other stakeholders
* Provide on-site support in relation to the implementation of social impact campaigns at FIFA events
* Manage campaign-related content on owned FIFA channels

We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

s.h: And we respect our values. Always.
s.t: For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

s.h: The specific competencies we require for this position are
s.t:
* Passion for football
* Proven experience (at least six years) working at an international and/or media organisation, with a specific campaign background
* Solid experience coordinating successful campaigns
* Media communications or public relations expertise and the ability to build and maintain interest over time
* Ability to see the bigger picture and think not just for Corporate Communications but for the FIFA Communications Division and the organisation as a whole
* Ability to liaise and communicate with and present to key stakeholders (internal and external)
* Excellent communicator and listener
* Willing to learn new skills and take on challenges
* Cooperative team player
* Bachelor-s degree in languages/communications/journalism/social studies (a master-s degree is a plus)
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills and management of messaging and the media
* Ability to work to tight deadlines
* Thorough understanding of global football activities and key football stakeholders
* Excellent command of communications platforms
* Expertise in video production and social media, as well as standard messaging and content creation
* SAP knowledge would be an asset (for the purposes of finance/budgeting, procurement, governance and RFP process management)
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office

The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
* **Health and fitness:** Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
* **Home office:** Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
* **Language courses:** Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
* **Continuous learning**: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
* **Pension:** Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
* **Relocation assistance:** A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
* **Sustainability:** We support all employees using public transport.
* **Vacation:** Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
* **Volunteering:** Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.
**Über FIFA**
We are FIFA, the global governing body for football.
Our vision is to make football truly global, diverse and inclusive, for the benefit of the entire world. The last FIFA World Cup in Qatar in 2022 attracted more than 5 billion viewers and the last FIFA Women-s World Cup in Australia and New Zealand in 2023 was the greatest-ever FIFA Women-s World Cup that inspired millions of girls and women around the globe. The opportunities for growth are exciting.
We are a modern organisation with over 800 passionate employees who are Living Football every day. Our headquarters are based in Zurich, Switzerland, and we have offices in Miami, Paris and Rabat, plus eleven regional offices from New Zealand to India, South Africa, Panama and Paraguay.
